name: nodehammer_connect.h
banner: The connector tier: hand over a geometry you already have in memory, get
`.nhb` bytes back. No nodehammer build, no library to link, no dependency
to install -- the only things left as real #includes are the C++ standard
library and the ROOT/DD4hep headers you already have.
Reading a file, writing one, and `formats()` are deliberately absent: each
dispatches through a format registry that reaches zstd, the one dependency
in this slice that is a compiled library rather than headers. Bytes are the
more useful primitive here anyway -- the destination is a socket.
